from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.vector_search import get_hybrid_ranking_engine

class Hou_Mcp_Hybrid_Ranking(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_hybrid_ranking"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("candidates",    "list")
        self.add_input("query_context", "any")
        self.add_input("vector_scores", "any")
        self.add_input("top_k",         "int", widget_type="int", default=10)
        self.add_output("ranked_assets", "list")
        self.add_output("top_asset_id",  "string")
        self.add_output("total",         "int")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        candidates    = inputs.get("candidates") or []
        query_context = inputs.get("query_context") or {}
        vector_scores = inputs.get("vector_scores") or {}
        top_k         = int(inputs.get("top_k") or 10)
        try:
            engine = get_hybrid_ranking_engine()
            ranked = engine.rank_assets(
                candidates=list(candidates) if isinstance(candidates, list) else [],
                query_context=dict(query_context) if isinstance(query_context, dict) else {},
                vector_scores=dict(vector_scores) if isinstance(vector_scores, dict) else {},
            )[:top_k]
            ranked_dicts = [r.to_dict() for r in ranked]
            top_id = ranked[0].asset_id if ranked else ""
            return {
                "ranked_assets": ranked_dicts,
                "top_asset_id":  top_id,
                "total":         len(ranked_dicts),
                "exec_out":      True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_hybrid_ranking failed: {e}")
            return {"ranked_assets": [], "top_asset_id": "", "total": 0, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Hybrid_Ranking
